signInUnavailable.title: We can't reach sign-in right now
signInUnavailable.body: You are still signed in, but we can't renew your session at the moment. Please try again in a minute.

signInRejected.title: This account can't be used here
signInRejected.body: You signed in, but this account can't be used with this workspace. It may be missing an email address. Please contact your administrator.

unavailable.title: We can't load your workspace right now
unavailable.body: Something on our side isn't responding. Please try again in a minute.

forbidden.title: This part of the workspace isn't open to you
forbidden.body: Your role doesn't include it. If you need it for your work, ask an administrator.

signInFailed.title: Sign-in did not complete
signInFailed.body: Your sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
